verdict.rationale: Smithery is an MCP registry and connection platform, so a built-in AI assistant is a fair capability to ask about. The evidence only documents REST connection management, a CLI for searching and calling tools, publishing, and triggers. Nothing shows an in-product assistant that a user can delegate tasks to; tool-calling primitives meant for external agents are developer building blocks, not a built-in assistant.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
